conclusion: Headless compositor artifact. The rectangle is the .stage background (#152c26) showing through a WebGL canvas that is transparent under the Card. It appears only with a headless capture while the Card is an overflow:auto scroll container, and it is absent in the headed capture of the same state. The product paints no element there.
elementAtPoint: document.elementsFromPoint(1134, 850) lists the WebGL canvas first; no DOM element with a background is above it at that point (compositor-check/probe-under-card.cjs).
finding: A solid forest rectangle under the expanded Card at 1440x900 (x ~994-1274, y ~790-880) in the headless Playwright captures.
variantSentence: Removing the Card (display none), fading it (opacity 0), removing its max-height (none), or switching its overflow to hidden or visible removes the rectangle; hiding the canvas leaves the stage colour; a red .stage background turns the rectangle red. Removing the box-shadow or the opacity transition does not.
